content: Ebook-Translator-Calibre-Plugin (bookfere), the closest existing analog to a multi-engine paid-API Calibre plugin (ChatGPT/OpenAI, Gemini, Azure ChatGPT, DeepL, Google Translate, custom): API keys stored as a plain-text list per engine (multiple keys supported, auto-switches to next on failure), entered via a plain text field/editor in settings — no OS keyring. Reviewed its setting.py source directly: there is NO cost estimator, NO usage/spend tracking, and NO free-vs-paid visual distinction between engines in the settings UI — all engines are presented uniformly regardless of whether they cost money. This is a real gap scourgify's per-engine cost-on-the-control (B4) fills; no found Calibre plugin shows a price before a paid batch job runs.
